items.text: Version 1.3.0 of the game represents 3 years of constant improvement and that is why we have decided to release the definitive edition, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5.
Do you have any suggestions to improve the experience?
-Cut-scenes precision problems throughout the game fixed
-Bugs when you get caught and the game freezes fixed
-View and rotate inventory items in real time without depending on FPS
